description:
The listings imported from a store's sales channels with import_channel_catalog, plus each channel's import state (catalog_read, last_run). Each listing is the channel's view: title, description, price, currency, channel_status (live/draft/archived/unknown), SKUs, variants and the channel's own image_url. made_in_apparelhub + product_uuid mark a listing ApparelHub created. scope "external" returns only the merchant's own listings (what they sold before ApparelHub), "ours" only ApparelHub-made ones, "all" both. TRACKED LISTINGS ARE NOT APPARELHUB PRODUCTS: you cannot sync, price-cascade, edit or fulfil them through ApparelHub, and they keep shipping exactly as today. Removed listings (gone from the channel) are hidden unless include_removed is true. Paged: limit 1-500 (default 100), offset. Read-only.

[#ab1488]

include_removed.description: Also return listings that have left the channel (removed_at set). Default false.

integration.description: Limit to one sales channel (its integration uuid).

scope.description: "external" = only listings ApparelHub did not create; "ours" = only ones it did. Default all.

workspace.description: Workspace uuid (agency accounts). Omit for the Default workspace.

name: list_tracked_listings
